meaning:
παρ-άλιος, -ον
(in cl., chiefly -α, -ον), [in LXX for יָם, חוֹף, etc., with prep. ;]
by the sea; ἡ π. (sc. χώρα, in LXX ἡ παραλία, Deu.1:7, Jos.9:1, Jdth.1:7, al.), the sea coast: Luk.6:17.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea…
